entities.summary: Macau is a sovereign nation in East Asia, Asia. Its capital is N/A (Macau Peninsula is administrative centre). Official languages include Chinese (Cantonese), Portuguese. Government: Special Administrative Region of the PRC. Population: approximately 0.7 million. Area: 33.7 km². Comprehensive index for Macau covering pre-colonial fishing settlements, Portuguese settlement 1557 (oldest European colony in East Asia), Jesuit missions, opium trade, Treaty of Peking 1887, WWII neutrality (Portuguese neutral), 12-3 Incident 1966, Organic Statute 1976, Sino-Portuguese Joint Declaration 1987, handover to China 1999, SAR status under 'one country two systems', casino liberalisation (2002), and rise as world's largest gambling hub.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Macau's strategic location and unique blend of Portuguese and Chinese cultures have made it a significant hub for international trade and finance, particularly in the opium trade and casino liberalisation. Its handover to China in 1999 marked a major shift in regional politics.
